observations: Whole and both halves personally read before the witnesses. Every body band enlarged, all overwritten text and mathematical letters/indices/arrows enlarged, and both oblique marginal notes rotated upright in crops. Literal Hom dans A and exist are retained. One typed underline is distinguished from its baseline serif. Quotation marks are paired strokes. Both inserted and cancelled states are inventoried. No context or outside transcription consulted.
